SOLID WASTE SERVICES
ALLEY RELOCATION PROGRAM
The Solid Waste Division (SW) offers
residents the opportunity to request their
solid waste services (trash, recycle and
bulk trash) be permanently relocated from
alley to curbside via a survey process.
Safety concerns, illegal dumping,
accidents and crimes are some examples
of why a survey may be requested. Once a
request for a survey is received, it’s typical
for the actual survey to take place within
six months of the request.
